text: Mozzart d.o.o. Beograd is a private Serbian betting company with 36 registered owners, all private individuals other than a 2.64% stake held by Eter Consulting d.o.o.; the largest shareholdings are Jadranka Stepanovic (40.98%) and Dejan Cakajac (38.35%).
short: Mozzart's largest owners are private individuals; no state or fund appears in the register.
